text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kh-f-fu~♪ I gotta give you credit, Royce! 
You actually remembered Windy-chan's 
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I was watching TV in the dorm... and a 
video wishing me happy birthday came on! 
That was such a huge surprise!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad you liked it. All according 
to plan, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...All according to plan? What do you mean 
by that?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san, you often watch the weather 
forecast on that same show, don't you? To 
plan whether today's prank should be 
outdoors or indoors...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for that exact time, I quietly 
played the recorded footage. And the 
result was a roaring success!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yeah. Indeed, I fell right into the 
trap...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Since it's Windy-san, who loves pranks, a 
top-tier surprise is part of the present! 
...? Windy-san...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you mention it, that's right! 
Everything went exactly the way you 
wanted...! That's so infuriating~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan can pull off... a way more 
amazing prank, nah-ha~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mark my words, Royce! For your birthday, 
I'm going to prepare a magnificent 
surprise for you~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, ahaha! Yes, I'll be looking 
forward to it!"
